name: @rask/panels
//: The estate's dock PANELS, and the state classes they read. It exists because a Svelte component only renders if it is IN the bundle: the global workbench zone imports panels that used to live inside three different zones, which is ordinary build-time sharing — the same mechanism @rask/ui already uses in all seven zones. No module federation, no iframes, no duplication. JIT like @rask/api: consumed as raw TS/Svelte with no build step, so a consumer's Tailwind `@source` points at src/ rather than dist/. NOTHING here may import `$lib/*` or `$app/*` — those aliases only exist inside a SvelteKit app, so every zone-shaped value (a base path, a navigate callback, an API client) arrives as a prop or a constructor argument.
